skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply economic theories and models to identify financial, monetary, and economic issues in real-world contexts.
Develop and enhance quantitative and qualitative analysis skills for evaluating policies and business decisions.
Master the ability to conduct literature reviews, synthesize secondary sources, and use analytical tools effectively.
Develop independent research skills, including problem-solving and critical thinking.
Enhance teamwork skills and the ability to organize group activities.
Improve presentation skills to effectively communicate research findings.
Strengthen self-learning abilities and the capacity for continuous learning.
Develop critical thinking skills to provide professional conclusions on practical issues.
Understand ethical responsibilities and the importance of social responsibility in professional activities.
Learn and apply various techniques for collecting and analyzing data.
Develop skills to create detailed research proposals and project plans.
Improve report writing skills, ensuring reports meet academic standards.
